# Final comprehensive test
python3 << 'EOF'
import json
import subprocess

tests = [
    # Test 1: Example from requirement - long column name
    {
        "name": "Long column name (65 chars)",
        "request": {"pipeline": {"steps": [{"op": "select", "columns": ["id", "x" * 65]}]}, "dataset": []},
        "should_fail": True,
        "error_code": "SCHEMA_VALIDATION_FAILED"
    },
    # Test 2: Exactly 64 characters (should pass)
    {
        "name": "Column name with 64 chars",
        "request": {"pipeline": {"steps": [{"op": "select", "columns": ["x" * 64]}]}, "dataset": []},
        "should_fail": False
    },
    # Test 3: Control character in column name
    {
        "name": "Column name with tab",
        "request": {"pipeline": {"steps": [{"op": "select", "columns": ["col\there"]}]}, "dataset": []},
        "should_fail": True,
        "error_code": "SCHEMA_VALIDATION_FAILED"
    },
    # Test 4: Valid complex pipeline with execute
    {
        "name": "Valid complex pipeline with execute",
        "request": {"pipeline": {"steps": [
            {"op": "select", "columns": ["id", "name"]},
            {"op": "filter", "where": "id > 0"},
            {"op": "map", "as": "upper_name", "expr": "name"}
        ]}, "dataset": [{"id": 1, "name": "Alice"}]},
        "should_fail": False,
        "with_execute": True
    }
]

passed = 0
failed = 0

for test in tests:
    args = ["--execute"] if test.get("with_execute") else []
    proc = subprocess.run(
        ["python", "etl_pipeline.py"] + args,
        input=json.dumps(test["request"]),
        capture_output=True,
        text=True
    )
    result = json.loads(proc.stdout)
    
    if test["should_fail"]:
        if result["status"] == "error" and result.get("error_code") == test.get("error_code"):
            print(f"✓ {test['name']}")
            passed += 1
        else:
            print(f"✗ {test['name']} - Expected error, got: {result}")
            failed += 1
    else:
        if result["status"] == "ok":
            print(f"✓ {test['name']}")
            passed += 1
        else:
            print(f"✗ {test['name']} - Got error: {result.get('message')}")
            failed += 1

print(f"\nPassed: {passed}, Failed: {failed}")
EOF
